## Context / Problem

Ticket `kneelength-coal-mollies` removed the Python facade and MCP `reconcile(mode=...)` tool, but its authorized file impact did not include `src/rebar/mcp_server.py`. During Gerrit LLM review and final residual sweep, stale prose/comment references remain in that file:

- module docstring lines describing MCP `reconcile` dry-run/live behavior
- environment help text saying reconcile is dry-run only
- comments around the legacy mode-cap binding that still refer to the reconcile tool

## Scope

Update `src/rebar/mcp_server.py` comments/docstrings/help text only, preserving any runtime symbols still needed by CLI/engine code or bridge operations. Also update the generated `server.json` MCP manifest when its mirrored environment help text contains the same stale reconcile prose.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `src/rebar/mcp_server.py` no longer describes a registered MCP `reconcile` tool.
- [x] Any retained mode-cap or environment text names the current explicit bridge operation that uses it, or is removed if obsolete.
- [x] No runtime behavior changes.
